datasets.name: PVGIS hourly PV output (SARAH3), 1 kWp reference system
datasets.publisher: European Commission, Joint Research Centre (PVGIS v5.3)
datasets.units: W per kWp (converted to kW per kWp); also T2m in deg C
datasets.license: PVGIS data free to use with attribution (c) European Union, JRC; verify terms at https://joint-research-centre.ec.europa.eu/photovoltaic-geographical-information-system-pvgis_en
datasets.preprocessing: UTC stamps floored to the hour, W->kW, clipped to [0,1] kW/kWp, converted to Europe/Berlin local time.
datasets.role: Actual on-site PV generation profile = capacity factor x installed kWp x scenario scale.

datasets.name: Day-ahead spot price, bidding zone DE-LU
datasets.publisher: Fraunhofer ISE Energy-Charts API; data from Bundesnetzagentur | SMARD.de
datasets.license: CC BY 4.0 (stated in the API response: 'CC BY 4.0 from Bundesnetzagentur | SMARD.de')
datasets.preprocessing: Resampled to hourly mean, /1000, local time. Negative prices kept in the spot series; the customer tariff is floored at 0.
datasets.role: Wholesale component of the electricity tariff (the tariff = spot x scale + network adder + levies).

datasets.name: Public net electricity generation by source, Germany
datasets.class: derived from public data + literature factors
datasets.publisher: Fraunhofer ISE Energy-Charts API (Bundesnetzagentur / ENTSO-E based)
datasets.license: Energy-Charts states CC BY 4.0 for its data (the API response itself carries no licence field; verify at https://www.energy-charts.info).
datasets.preprocessing: Per-source MW averaged hourly; null/negative -> 0; carbon intensity = sum(generation x emission factor) / sum(generation). Imports/exports and pumped-storage charging excluded (production-based intensity).

datasets.name: Emission factors per generation technology
datasets.publisher: IPCC AR5 WGIII (2014) Annex III, Table A.III.2 (median lifecycle): coal 820, gas CCGT 490, biomass 230, geothermal 38, hydro 24, nuclear 12, solar PV utility 48, onshore wind 11, offshore wind 12 gCO2e/kWh
datasets.license: IPCC reports: free for non-commercial use with citation
datasets.preprocessing: Lignite (1000), oil (650), coal-derived gas (600), waste (400), others (500) are ANALYST ASSUMPTIONS (not IPCC values) - see config/default.yaml.
datasets.role: Convert the generation mix into carbon intensity.

datasets.name: Time-of-use network charge + levies
datasets.preprocessing: Schedules A (training) and B (OOD) defined in config/default.yaml; they mimic peak/shoulder/off-peak structures but are not a real utility tariff.
datasets.role: Peak / intermediate / off-peak structure added to the real spot price.

datasets.name: Industrial base load, production jobs, deadlines, forecast errors, PV drops
datasets.preprocessing: Generated by energyrl/scenarios.py from seeded random draws; no real plant data was used (none freely available at suitable resolution).
datasets.role: Flexible/inflexible loads, job power, durations, release times, deadlines.
